bootstrap.method: crossed paired learning-seed × traffic-seed percentile bootstrap
bootstrap.interpretation: exploratory; three learning seeds do not establish broad algorithm superiority

manifest.selection: Validation only. Every learning seed is retained and evaluated; no selection on final tests.

searchProtocol.order: seeded starting aisle, then systematic cyclic sweep
searchProtocol.admission: common on-site vehicle count limited to bay capacity; no remote location info to drivers
searchProtocol.reservation: guided: at entrance; search: on local discovery
searchProtocol.loop: shared physical perimeter return, no artificial time penalty

manifest.policyReuse: v0.4 guided policies retained; added positive return cycle leaves all guided paths and observations unchanged
